items.exampleEn: It's normal to feel tired after a long trip.
items.exampleZh: 長途旅行後覺得累是很正常的。

items.exampleEn: Please drive slowly near the school.
This table is made of wood.

items.exampleZh: 那張桌子是什麼形狀的？

items.exampleEn: Can I ask you a quick question?
items.exampleZh: 可以簡單問你一個問題嗎？

items.exampleEn: The shop gives free samples of its cookies.
items.exampleZh: 這家店提供免費的餅乾試吃。

items.exampleEn: I walk every day to stay fit.
items.exampleZh: 我每天走路來保持健康。

items.sentenceEn: Please speak slowly. My English is not good.
items.sentenceZh: 請說慢一點，我的英文不好。

items.audioEn: The cookies come in different shapes, like stars and hearts.
items.audioZh: 這些餅乾有各種不同的形狀，像是星星和愛心。
items.questionZh: 這些餅乾有什麼特別的地方？
options: They are very big and soft

items.sentenceEn: I had a quick lunch at my desk.
items.sentenceZh: 我在辦公桌前很快地吃了午餐。

items.sentenceEn: She speaks in a soft voice.

items.stemEn: Everything is ____ today. Nothing strange happened.
items.stemZh: 今天一切正常，沒發生什麼奇怪的事。

items.stemEn: My grandfather swims every day, so he is very ____.
items.stemZh: 我爺爺每天游泳，所以身體很健康。

items.passageEn: Ben makes small toys out of wood. He works slowly and carefully. First, he cuts the wood into the right shape. Then he paints it in bright colors. At the market, children can play with a sample toy before their parents buy one. "For me, this is a normal day," Ben says. "It keeps my hands busy and my mind happy."
items.passageZh: Ben 用木頭做小玩具。他做得又慢又仔細。他先把木頭切成合適的形狀，再漆上鮮豔的顏色。在市集裡，孩子們可以先玩樣品玩具，爸媽再決定要不要買。Ben 說：「對我來說，這就是平常的一天。它讓我的手有事做，心情也很好。」

options: 把木頭切成合適的形狀
先幫每個玩具上好顏色

questions.questionZh: 孩子們在爸媽買玩具前可以做什麼？

rubricZh: 副詞 slowly 放在動詞後面（例如 walks slowly、walks very slowly）
第三人稱單數的動詞要加 s（例如 walks）

items.instructionZh: 用 shape 造一個句子，描述一樣東西的形狀。
referenceEn: This cookie is in the shape of a star.
My new desk has a strange shape.
rubricZh: shape 表示「形狀」，可寫例如 in the shape of a star、has a strange shape
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 This cookie is、My desk has）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：新規則：mcq 四選項同詞性（形容詞），只能靠詞義判斷
執行長第②③關裁示修正：選項釋義同步
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 ["健康的","柔軟的","正常的","慢的"]（原 ["健康的","木頭","形狀","慢慢地"]）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關："Can I ask you a quick question?" 譯成「我可以很快地問你一個問題嗎？」是直譯、不道地；台灣說法為「我可以問你一個小問題嗎？」或「可以簡單問你一下嗎？」。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "可以簡單問你一個問題嗎？"（原 "我可以很快地問你一個問題嗎？"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似：末句 "It keeps my hands busy and my body fit." ——做木頭小玩具「又慢又仔細」、坐著上色，說能讓身體保持 fit 邏輯偏弱；可補一句他走路去市集，或改成 "my mind happy"。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Ben makes small toys out of wood. He works slowly and carefully. First, he cuts the wood into the right shape. Then he paints it in bright colors. At the market, children can play with a sample toy before their parents buy one. \"For me, this is a normal day,\" Ben says. \"It keeps my hands busy and my mind happy.\""（原 "Ben makes small toys out of wood. He works slowly and carefully. First, he cuts the wood into the right shape. Then he paints it in bright colors. At the market, children can play with a sample toy before their parents buy one. \"For me, this is a normal day,\" Ben says. \"It keeps my hands busy and my body fit.\""）
